brief:
The Guardian newspaper has urged governments to impose a comprehensive trade embargo on Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. The British publication argued that restricting imports of settlement products alone does not constitute sufficient action to halt settlement expansion.

The call reflects growing international pressure over accelerating Israeli settlement activity in occupied Palestinian territories. The Guardian's stance represents a more stringent position than current policies adopted by some governments, which have limited themselves to labeling settlement goods or banning specific products from settlements rather than implementing broader economic measures against the entire settlement enterprise.
